releases.name: Earth Day Drop (2024)
releases.quote: This Earth Day Collection brings fresh items and new twists on favorites from our Earth Day Drop.
releases.note: The one-of-a-kind and three-made pieces here came from a tip war Tom ran for charity. They're variations on the Creature drop, so they weren't really a Creature Club release.

releases.name: Creature Club Bunbud Giveaways
releases.quote: 🐰 Creature Club Exclusive Bunbud Giveaways: Starting tomorrow! We're giving out a new Bunbud every 2 weeks, exclusively for our Creature Club members.

releases.name: Earth Collection
releases.quote: **🌍 Earth Collection:** Launching this Thursday! This collection expands on the items dropped for Earth Day and will be available for 90 days at the Creature Store.

releases.name: Creature Club Sponsored Game Jam (2024)
releases.quote: Creature Club will be sponsoring the next Highrise Game Jam: a world creation contest where players will create a simple 2D room using Highrise Studio. The event starts on Saturday, the 6th, and submissions will be accepted until July 20th. Participating is super easy ...

items.n: Mint Creature Club Scout Leader Hat

releases.quote: Someone has kicked off production on our next Creature Club grab, featuring a fun summer camp and scouts theme. No release date yet!

releases.name: Valentine's Day Store Update (2025)
releases.quote: 💖 **Creature Club Valentine’s Day Store Update** – New items perfect for **gifting friends** (or yourself). Expect some **small themed drops** leading up to Valentine’s Day.

releases.name: Creature Bloody Rose Valentine's Flash Drop (2025)
Creature Store Weekly Deals: Magenta Mayhem
releases.quote: 🛍️ **Creature Store – Weekly Deals** – Starting this month, **tees, shoes, and accessories** will be added to the **Creature Store every Friday**. Keep an eye out for new additions each week.

Creature Gold Bars (Coin Wrapping Experiment)
releases.quote: **Creature Gold Bars are now live as a limited time experiment.** You can wrap your Creature Coins into a bar and make them tradable, giving players a new way to buy Creature Coins directly from you. When they recycle a bar, they get 5,000 Creature Coins...

releases.name: Creature Store Limited Collection (November 2025)
releases.quote: A new collection clothing is also available, for a limited time, in the Creature Store!

releases.name: Krampi Snugglin
releases.note: Sold in the Creature Store for 50,000 Creature Coins. The egg hatches Krampi, the black Krampus Snugglin with mint eyes.

releases.name: Evil Eye Oath Hoodie Giveaway
releases.quote: Note: The winners for the limited Evil Eye Oath Hoodie will be receiving the reward today! Please report any issues you spot with the item if any!

releases.name: Year 4 Anniversary Drop
releases.quote: ## 🛍️ Year 4 Anniversary Drop — **The drop is this Saturday, January 17th**, for all Creature Club members. A collection of themed items will be available in the Creature Store shortly afterwards!

releases.name: Krambi Snugglin
releases.note: Given away to Creature Club members. Krambi is Krampi's pink counterpart, down to the teddy, the coal bag and the halo.

releases.name: HCC x Nugs: Creature Misfits & Cuties Club
releases.quote: # HCC x Nugs: Creature Misfits & Cuties Club is live! Cuties - 150 creature coins per spin / Misfits - 120 creature coins per spin / Both come with animated roller skates! 🛼✨ Outside Creature Club? Grabs are up for a horribly overpriced amount of gold!
